messages:
maya_support: Heads-up — acme-prod reported p99 jump from ~220ms -> ~1.4s since 03:05 UTC, lots of 504/timeout+retry. No config changes on their side. Request ids: req=147228, req=147230. Can eng-runtime take?

joel_eng_runtime: on it. Any logs? which model/variant?

maya_support: model=rexd-8k-quant, route=chat.generate, avg tokens ~128. Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T03:06:12Z] gpu-alloc ERROR: OOM while reserving 1.2GiB (device 0)
[2026-03-15T03:06:12Z] kv_cache WARN: tenant=acme-prod kv_size=4.1GiB kv_entries=3.2M
[2026-03-15T03:06:13Z] slab_evict INFO: evicted 1024 slabs, compaction=low
[2026-03-15T03:06:14Z] serve TRACE: p99=1400ms p95=600ms
```

joel_eng_runtime: looks like KV growth + slab fragmentation causing high fail/retry path. Two immediate mitigations: 1) toggle aggressive kv eviction (ttl) for tenant, 2) reduce max_batch_size for route. I'll push a config change; SRE might want to drain/restart a subset.

ashley_sre: agree. Also seeing `alloc_heat` high on device. Recommend rolling subset of nodes to apply allocator tuning: set `slab_compact_threshold=0.3` and `allocator_backpressure_ms=20`. I'll coordinate a rolling restart of 2/6 nodes off-peak.

li_devops: commands to toggle kv eviction via admin API:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/acme-prod/config \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
 -d '{"kv_eviction_policy":"aggressive_ttl","kv_ttl_seconds":900}'
```
Also reduce batch size for route:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routes/chat.generate/config -d '{"max_batch_size":16}'
```

joel_eng_runtime: applied kv_eviction_policy=aggressive_ttl, set kv_ttl_seconds=900, and route max_batch_size=16 for acme-prod at 03:18 UTC. Watching metrics now.

maya_support: customer reports improvement — p99 down to ~320ms after config, some 502s still. They saw fewer OOM logs.

joel_eng_runtime: good. Follow-up: plan to cap KV per-tenant (soft limit 3GiB) and add periodic kv compaction job. We'll also ship allocator param change in next rollout. Adding action items.

ashley_sre: I'll schedule rolling restart of 2 nodes at 04:00 UTC with tuned allocator flags. Expect short increase in tail while nodes drain.

joel_eng_runtime: note for product: fallback policy to smaller model variant after N retries would reduce impact of kv pressure. Filing ticket.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-20260315-09, priority=P2, owner=joel_eng_runtime.

maya_support: customer confirmation: after restarts and eviction policy, no more 504s, p99 stable ~260ms. Marking resolved on our side. :tada:

li_devops: Postmortem tasks: 1) implement per-tenant KV cap + hard eviction, 2) expose kv_size in tenant dashboard, 3) allocator tuning rollout (slab_compact_threshold), 4) docs on emergency mitigations.

joel_eng_runtime: filing follow-up RFC for long-term changes, will link ticket here.

ashley_sre: closing loop — I'll monitor overnight and reopen if we see recurrence.
